name: v0.2.133-testing-alpha
body:
## Viridite — v0.2.133-testing-alpha

Automated build via GitHub Actions. Bundles the launcher + both Translation Core binaries — drag `Viridite.nro` and the `Viridite/` folder from `Viridite-sdcard.zip` straight onto your SD card's `/switch/` folder.

### Launcher (Viridite) changes

- launcher: clearing the cache must not strip a game to 32-bit (1c651ac, 2026-08-08)

### AHNX-Translation-Core changes (most recent commits)

- core: an install that lost its arm64 libs is stale, not a 32-bit game (161ee25, 2026-08-08)
- arm32: register shifts, scalbn, and pthread_once actually running (78dfbf7, 2026-08-08)
- arm32: VMOV core-pair was dead code, and VLD1 could not splat (f135d52, 2026-08-08)
- arm32: the unconditional space is not ordinary instructions (22e66cd, 2026-08-08)
- arm32: a memory barrier is not a conditional branch (3cf230e, 2026-08-08)
- arm32: implement VMOV immediate and the AEABI zero-fill helpers (a56cffe, 2026-08-08)
- arm32: reading PC as an operand must give the architectural value (c7620ce, 2026-08-08)
- arm32: a game asking the time must not get told the time never moves (96d0d2f, 2026-08-08)
- core: the reveal is drawn, and achievements arrive while you play (d22014c, 2026-08-07)
- core: the loading screen is no longer the logo (fc4ce05, 2026-08-04)
- core: stop the boot sequence being able to abort the process (40da875, 2026-08-04)
- core: the Viridite reveal, with the jingle, fading into the game (0b81ac5, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: printf, NEON immediates, and a boot jingle (def11e1, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: PC reads as +8, and NEON is no longer decoded as a byte store (0c0e1bb, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: fix an overflow in __strcat_chk, and say which half of the canary failed (8c1bf64, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: bridge the imports the game reaches once it starts running (9129354, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: catch a runaway PC at the text boundary, and widen the trace (bae4ae7, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: stop closing the log before the game runs (4c3952e, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: render on the thread that owns the GL context (08f1f22, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: actually run the game — GL bridge and frame loop (334e4d2, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: skip a halted constructor instead of ending the run (de4c23e, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: record control transfers so a bad branch names itself (24dbbe8, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: implement BLX (immediate) — the halt was a missing mode switch (054a252, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: give imported data symbols real memory instead of a call sentinel (d1de576, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: implement LDRD/STRD, table branches and exclusives (70b266c, 2026-08-03)
- core: name the host when a game reaches for the network (eba7f5b, 2026-08-03)
- core: a dry run must not start a 32-bit game (b27f7be, 2026-08-03)
- core: resolve every 32-bit import for Hill Climb Racing 1.70 and HCR2 (e3668a6, 2026-08-03)
- core: quiet the engine sweep from the rate, not from a timer (0ca2af0, 2026-08-03)
- core: check the arena at the moment the game allocates, not on a timer (602887c, 2026-08-03)

### Build info

- Launcher commit: `1c651ac24c104a5ee8c0bfb1a9817e63f1ceec15`
- Translation Core commit: `161ee2503dd9c6919ea347d7e0b9b1df152c55a5`
- Built: 2026-08-08 19:43 UTC
- Triggered by: @aaronateataco

### Launcher (Viridite) changes



### AHNX-Translation-Core changes (most recent commits)

- arm32: reading PC as an operand must give the architectural value (c7620ce, 2026-08-08)
- arm32: a game asking the time must not get told the time never moves (96d0d2f, 2026-08-08)
- core: the reveal is drawn, and achievements arrive while you play (d22014c, 2026-08-07)
- core: the loading screen is no longer the logo (fc4ce05, 2026-08-04)
- core: stop the boot sequence being able to abort the process (40da875, 2026-08-04)
- core: the Viridite reveal, with the jingle, fading into the game (0b81ac5, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: printf, NEON immediates, and a boot jingle (def11e1, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: PC reads as +8, and NEON is no longer decoded as a byte store (0c0e1bb, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: fix an overflow in __strcat_chk, and say which half of the canary failed (8c1bf64, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: bridge the imports the game reaches once it starts running (9129354, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: catch a runaway PC at the text boundary, and widen the trace (bae4ae7, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: stop closing the log before the game runs (4c3952e, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: render on the thread that owns the GL context (08f1f22, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: actually run the game — GL bridge and frame loop (334e4d2, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: skip a halted constructor instead of ending the run (de4c23e, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: record control transfers so a bad branch names itself (24dbbe8, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: implement BLX (immediate) — the halt was a missing mode switch (054a252, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: give imported data symbols real memory instead of a call sentinel (d1de576, 2026-08-04)
- arm32: implement LDRD/STRD, table branches and exclusives (70b266c, 2026-08-03)
- core: name the host when a game reaches for the network (eba7f5b, 2026-08-03)
- core: a dry run must not start a 32-bit game (b27f7be, 2026-08-03)
- core: resolve every 32-bit import for Hill Climb Racing 1.70 and HCR2 (e3668a6, 2026-08-03)
- core: quiet the engine sweep from the rate, not from a timer (0ca2af0, 2026-08-03)
- core: check the arena at the moment the game allocates, not on a timer (602887c, 2026-08-03)
- core: monitor the allocator continuously instead of checking it by hand (ebc4427, 2026-08-03)
- core: cache glyph widths — the last allocation on the loading screen (1ae9f26, 2026-08-03)
- core: take the last allocations out of the loading screen (8a0d99e, 2026-08-03)
- core: keep the loading screen off the allocator, and check top is a chunk (517de05, 2026-08-03)
- core: dry-test one selected game, and flush results as they are written (a919d06, 2026-08-03)
- core: dry-run mode that loads every game without running any of it (4c096d3, 2026-08-03)
